messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

### Most important signaling test capabilities
| Capability area | Why it matters for semiconductor / wireless device work | R&S-supported capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Multi-technology network emulation | Modern wireless chipsets/devices need cellular and WLAN validation in one environment. | R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD. [17][18] | [17][18] |
| 5G NR signaling and RF measurements | Cellular modem validation needs NR signaling plus RF parametric testing. | CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus LTE signaling and measurements. [18] | [18] |
| WLAN signaling across Wi-Fi generations | Wi-Fi chipset/device validation needs AP/STA signaling for current and next-generation WLAN. | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO. [18] | [18] |
| Wi-Fi 7 signaling and MLO/MIMO validation | Wi-Fi 7 R&D requires real-world RF TX/RX, multi-link and multi-RF-chain testing. | CMX500 Wi-Fi 7 R&D test scenarios include signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities. [7] | [7] |
| Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn early RF signaling | Next-generation WLAN silicon/device work needs pre-ratification PHY feature validation. | R&S says CMX500 has implemented first Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn RF signaling tests before final ratification and demonstrated them with a Broadcom prototype next-generation WLAN device. [1][4] | [1][4] |
| Wi-Fi 8 dRU and UEQM testing | Wi-Fi 8 introduces new PHY test hurdles tied to reliability and modulation adaptation. | Wi-Fi 8 testing hurdles include distributed resource units and unequal modulation; dRU measurements verify uplink transmit-power boosting and connection-reliability improvement, while UEQM analysis evaluates whether the DUT correctly adapts modulation according to specified MCS combinations. [1] | [1] |
| AP and station role coverage | Semiconductor WLAN devices may need validation as AP, station, or both. | CMX500 WLAN signaling options include 802.11bn STA testing basic and 802.11bn AP testing basic, plus 802.11ax/802.11be STA and AP testing options. [24] | [24] |
| MIMO signaling | Multi-antenna WLAN and cellular devices require MIMO validation. | CMX500 includes WLAN signaling 2x2 MIMO single user, and its NR signaling enabler includes DL 2x2/4x4 MIMO. [24] | [24] |
| Fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput and PER | Robustness and performance testing require controlled impairment and link-quality metrics. | CMX500 supports fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement. [18] | [18] |
| Application, IP traffic, IMS and audio quality | Chipset/device validation often extends beyond RF into E2E services and IP behavior. | CMX500 supports application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA; CMX-KA100 provides DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and Max Throughput Wizard, while CMX-KA150 provides IP traffic analysis and CMX-KA181 adds POLQA. [18][21] | [18][21] |
| WLAN offload / cellular-WLAN interworking | Devices using both cellular and Wi-Fi need interworking and voice-continuity testing. | CMX500 was used to demonstrate 5G and WLAN traffic offloading/interworking; its integrated N3IWF gateway can test WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN and integrated POLQA voice quality measurement. [7] | [7] |
| OTA signaling for realistic antenna/device validation | Wireless devices need OTA validation when antenna and device-level behavior matter. | MVG integrated CMX500 OBT full WLAN signaling test functionality, including Wi-Fi 7, into WaveStudio so manufacturers can run 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling testing in a single antenna measurement system. [11][12] | [11][12] |
| 4G/5G/WLAN OTA multi-technology validation | OTA chambers can validate multi-RAT behavior beyond conducted testing. | CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS supports 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA EN-DC, LTE and WLAN OTA tests, including Wi-Fi 7 320 MHz bandwidth support. [25] | [25] |
| NTN, NB-NTN and direct-to-cell signaling | Satellite/direct-to-cell capable chipsets need NTN-specific signaling and RF/application testing. | CMX500 supports NR-NTN, NB-NTN and DTC, and can execute RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility and application testing. [50] | [50] |
| Automation and remote control | Semiconductor validation labs need repeatable automated test execution. | CMX500 provides GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control. [18] | [18] |
| Production/non-signaling RF measurement | Production test may need high-throughput RF generator/analyzer capability rather than signaling. | R&S CMP180 is a radio communication tester for production and wireless communication device testing, configurable with multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability. [33] | [33] |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Connectable need | Knowledge-base-confirmed option / specification | Why it fits | Evidence | Gaps / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Cellular + WLAN signaling, network emulation, RF/application testing | LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD; WLAN signaling/TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn; 2x2 MIMO; fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput and PER. [17][18] | Core one-box platform for signaling-based device validation across 5G, LTE and WLAN. [17][18] | [17][18] | Formal software versions, option stack and hardware configuration must be confirmed from official specs/configuration; feature overview data without tolerance limits is not binding. [20] |
| R&S CMX500 application/IP/audio options | E2E application, IP traffic, IMS voice and audio quality testing | CMX-KA100, KA110, KA150, KA180, KA181 and KA401 cover internal IP services, QoS/ePDG/N3IWF, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA and file-based audio tests. [21][22] | Extends signaling tests into application-layer and service-quality validation. [21] | [21][22] | POLQA option version and detailed test conditions are not always specified in PR sources. [9] |
| R&S CMX500 OBT with OTA systems | OTA signaling for 4G/5G/WLAN/Wi-Fi 7 | MVG WaveStudio integrates CMX500 OBT full WLAN signaling including Wi-Fi 7 and supports 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling; Bluetest RTS integration supports 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, LTE and WLAN OTA testing. [11][12][25] | Useful when antenna, OTA, MIMO or full-device behavior must be tested instead of only conducted RF. [11][25] | [11][12][25] | MVG/Bluetest passages do not specify CMX500 OBT hardware configuration, RF chain count, software option code, full test cases or uncertainty. [15][29] |

[1][4][24] | Test case list, uncertainty, pass/fail criteria, standard draft version and conformance applicability are not provided. [2] |
| Wi-Fi 7 device R&D | CMX500 Wi-Fi 7 signaling plus MLO/MIMO test setup | Focus on signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz discovery, coexistence and E2E testing. [7] | Software version, license/option code, hardware configuration and RF chain count are not specified in the PR source. [9] |
| Cellular + WLAN interworking | CMX500 application/IP options plus WLAN/5G signaling | Use N3IWF, WLAN offload with Voice over WLAN and POLQA voice quality measurement. [7][21] | N3IWF option code, supported standards version, interop scope and configuration limits are not specified in the PR source. [9] |
| OTA device validation | CMX500 OBT integrated with MVG or Bluetest OTA systems | Use OTA signaling for 4G, 5G and WLAN, including Wi-Fi 7, in antenna or reverberation/multiprobe test systems. [11][12][25] | Chamber model, probe count, RF chains, calibration procedure, full test case list and measurement uncertainty are not listed. [15][29] |
| NTN / direct-to-cell device work | CMX500 NTN / DTC signaling setup | Use CMX500 for NR-NTN, NB-NTN and DTC RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility and application testing. [50] | Formal test methods, limits, tolerances, test case IDs and validation status must be checked in standards and official product documentation. [54] |

- UEQM analysis 被描述為可評估 test device 是否能依 specified modulation coding scheme（MCS）combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

R&S CMX500 OBT › Bluetest RTS / OTA test 語境
依 [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 可與 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）及 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 搭配。
- 支援使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 Bluetest RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。
- [[Bluetest]] 也將較早的 [[WLAN]] stations / access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）integrated testing capabilities 擴充到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 320 MHz bandwidth support。
- 來源將此整合定位為 single tester and reverberation test system 的 multi-technology validation path。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。
